thread:
oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-15T09:02Z — elevated error rate observed on KV cache reuse path (service: runtime-gateway, impact: degraded generation correctness) :rotating_light:

mike.h: seeing customer reports + telemetry spikes for bad responses. error class looks like 'kv_seq_mismatch' and we have repeated token misalignments. 
  example from logs: `WARN kv_cache: reuse_seq=5421 request_seq=5412 key=conv-12345`

sara.p: alerted by SLO alert (gen_correctness_rate < 99.0%) at 09:00 UTC. Pager fired. I'm on it, will gather initial blast radius.

alex.r: we shipped a batching/kv reuse change in the runtime yesterday (optimize: reuse cache across batched requests when model and seq aligned). suspect that heuristic missed some edge cases when requests include mixed partial prefix/stop tokens.

jamie: Support: multiple customers reported hallucinated slot values and truncated outputs. One enterprise tenant has 3% of calls affected, flagged by sampling.

mike.h: ok priority: stop further reuse to prevent cross-request leakage. Can we flip the feature flag?

alex.r: yes -> there is a runtime gate: KV_REUSE_ENABLED (feature-flagged per-deploy). I can push a hotfix to disable reuse globally. Impact: CPU/latency cost will go up a bit but correctness restored.

sara.p: do it. Notify customers and fill incident template. I'll start triage doc and run impact queries.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: alex.r/kv-reuse-disable -> env=prod -> rolling_start at 09:07 UTC.

alex.r: patch applied to canary at 09:07. Observability: dropping reuse hits to 0 on canary nodes. Monitoring now.

mike.h: what quick mitigation until full rollout? route traffic away from legacy runtime instance pool that still has old binary. We have routing weight control in smart-router. I can shift 30% off the old pool to new canary immediately.

oncall-bot: handoff: sara.p -> oncall rotation will annotate. Next oncall: alex.r in 2h for followups.

jamie: Customer comms: sending status notice that we detected cache reuse correctness issue, mitigation in progress (disabling reuse), potential increased latency. Draft ready, needs Liz review.

liz: I'll send the customer-facing note to the affected tenants around 09:15 with temporary mitigation and ETA for full mitigation.

09:12 - alex.r: canary metrics: gen_correctness_rate back to baseline (99.95%) on canary, error rate down. Rolling to 50% now.

09:20 - deploy-bot: rollout at 09:20 to 100% complete. KV_REUSE_ENABLED = false across prod.

mike.h: verify regression tests for seq offsets triggered locally — I ran the failing scenario and the output aligns now. Example: before: `response tokens misaligned at offset 12`, after: `no mismatch`

09:30 - sara.p: blast radius query: about 0.9% of total calls in last 24h saw potential misuse of reused keys (peak around 09:00). Most customers unaffected, but three tenants had visible quality regressions.

alex.r: root cause hypothesis: a race in continuous batching where the KV cache reuse decision used an older request's seq_end offset when two requests from same connection overlapped and the batching window reused the cache key without updating seq pointer. So stale seq -> wrong values pulled.

mike.h: reproduction notes: trigger with two concurrent partial-streaming requests on same connection with different stop tokens, batch window 10ms, KV reuse enabled. I've added a failing unit that simulates overlapping seqs.

09:45 - alex.r: next steps: (1) leave reuse disabled until we ship correctness fix (guard reuse on strict seq equality and per-request nonce). (2) add ops counters to detect reuse hits where seq != expected. (3) ship regression test and new release by EOD.

sara.p: I'm moving this to incident postmortem template and scheduling a blameless RCA meeting at 14:00 UTC. Adding incident severity: Sev2 (correctness but mitigated quickly).

jamie: CS note: proactively refunding token costs for affected tenants and offering extended monitoring.

10:05 - liz: customer note sent. Acknowledged by one major tenant, they appreciate rapid mitigation.

alex.r: quick patch PR details (link hidden in-thread): change-match from 'compatible_model && same_shard' to 'compatible_model && same_shard && seq_start == cache_seq_end && request_nonce == cache_nonce'. Also added a fail-safe that disables reuse if overlap_detected counter > 0 for 1m.

mike.h: please include a migration plan for Dedicated customers running older private runtime packages — we need to push out a security advisory and patch for on-prem images.

13:55 - sara.p: postmortem skeleton prepared. Will include timeline, impact per-customer, code snippets, and prevention actions: stronger tests around batching windows, adding canary fuzzing, and opt-in telemetry for reuse anomalies.

14:00 - Incident followup meeting scheduled. Attendees: eng-runtime, eng-sre, support, cs.

final notes: severity downgraded to informational after fix verified. Root cause: KV cache reuse heuristic allowed stale seq reuse under rare batching overlap. Mitigation: disable reuse, rollout bugfix enforcing exact seq+nonce checks, add telemetry and customer remediation.

/END OF THREAD
